answer: Operator-Linked Egress Revocation: each agent request carries an operator-signed delegation certificate bound to the operator’s control-plane key and egress ASN. A correlation service clusters wallets by certificate lineage and network egress; sybil-like fan-out triggers suspension of the operator’s issuance key and revocation of every descendant agent, while wallet balances remain untouched. Recovery needs independent audit and rekeying. Attacker cost: all live agents lose API access and revenue across timber provenance, relic custody, and reef sensing, plus audit delay.
